title: Mechanical Engineer
summary: Support design, installation and commissioning of mechanical systems on complex engineering and data centre projects.
description: Support design, installation and commissioning of mechanical systems on complex engineering and data centre projects.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Assist with system design, drawing reviews and technical documentation.
Support installation, inspection, testing and commissioning against project milestones.
Identify technical defects and improve engineering processes.
Coordinate project teams, subcontractors and clients and maintain records.
Follow environmental, health and safety regulations.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Degree, HND or equivalent in mechanical engineering or related discipline.
Mechanical design/installation experience; construction, engineering or data centre background advantageous.
Ability to read technical drawings and specifications and use IT/reporting tools.
Proof of eligibility to work in Europe; clean driving licence desirable.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Detail-oriented, collaborative and proactive technical problem-solving.
